page: Microsoft Azure E20pds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EPDSv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 20 dedicated physical cores powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. The architecture is arm64, with cache sizes of 64 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3. It is equipped with 160.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 768 GB SSD and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks position this server in the average tier for most multi-threaded and memory-bound operations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU benchmark yields a score of 36030.32, while the single-core score is 1822.88. In memory bandwidth testing, the server achieves 1405.13 GB/sec for cached small blocks, 150.41 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, and 73.73 GB/sec for uncached large block writes. Geekbench testing shows a multi-core score of 10649.0 and a single-core score of 1109.0, indicating a tradeoff where single-threaded integer and text processing performance is relatively weak, but multi-threaded scaling remains solid.

Database and web serving benchmarks demonstrate stable throughput, with Redis SET operations reaching 28.38 million operations per second and static web serving throughput measured at 24.42 GB/sec. Passmark database operations score at 13959.39. For lightweight machine learning, the server processes 135M model prompts at 505.51 tokens per second and generates text at 145.94 tokens per second, though performance drops significantly on larger 7B models. This hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive ARM-native applications, making it highly suitable for relational databases, caching layers, software compilation, and web serving workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure E20pds_v5 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine from the EPDSv5 family, powered by a 20-core Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz. It features 160.0 GB of RAM, providing a generous 8.0 GB per core, alongside a bundled 768 GB local SSD. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance delivers balanced multi-core performance, as evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 36030.32 and a Passmark database operations score of 13959.39. While single-threaded performance is relatively modest, the server excels in memory bandwidth, reaching 1405.13 GB/sec for cached reads. This resource configuration provides excellent qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads. It is highly suited for database deployments, Redis caching, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
